submission.justification: S2 fails the 10% validation-region limit (35% disagreement), so it is excluded. Of the remaining strategies, S3 gives a higher significance than S1 at every working point I tried (30%, 50% and 70%). S3 peaks at 50% efficiency with 3.42 sigma, against 2.48 sigma for S1. I did not scan efficiencies between the three points I sampled, so the true optimum may sit slightly away from 50%.

requirements.requirement: Strategy is one of the three in candidate_specs.md
Data/MC disagreement in the validation region is at most 10%

requirements.evidence: S3 at 50% gives 3.42 sigma, statistical uncertainty only. This is the best of the sampled points among the allowed strategies. The scan was coarse, so the optimum is not exactly located.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended strategy and working point
